neighbours.label: The piece 'ol'/'ole'/'oles' that follows a split ' ind' (indole, indolent, indolence), vs other words that begin with ' ind'
fire: Bacteria in the gut convert tryptophan into indole and other compounds.
The lymphoma was indolent, so the doctors chose to watch and wait.
Several plant hormones are indoles derived from the same amino acid.
Critics blamed the failure on the indolence of the city council.
Most indolent tumours grow slowly over many years.
The smell of indole is unpleasant at high concentrations.
He spent an indolent summer reading by the lake.
Indoleacetic acid controls how roots and shoots grow.
quiet: Bacteria in the gut convert tryptophan into serotonin and other compounds.

Several plant hormones are made from the same amino acid in the shoot.
Critics blamed the failure on the indifference of the city council.
Most individual tumours grow slowly over many years.
The smell of the industrial plant is unpleasant on hot days.
He spent an indoor summer reading by the window.
Indian scientists studied how roots and shoots grow.
